summary: Test-only revision adding regression coverage for CLI envelope schema validation and malformed-envelope rejection in collector_test.go. Traced each case through decodeCLIEnvelope and runJSON: schema mismatch, malformed/non-object/trailing JSON, missing fields, and null args all produce *CLIError on the offending command, and collection stops at the first failing envelope. go test ./... and go vet ./... both exit 0. Revision contains origin/master and fast-forwards it.
